name: orbitwrite
description: Plan, draft, schedule and publish social posts through your Orbitwrite workspace on X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Discord. Bundles the orbitwrite skill and the hosted Orbitwrite MCP server.

orbitwrite.note: Hosted Orbitwrite MCP server (streamable HTTP). Authenticates with a workspace API key from Settings, then API keys, read from the ORBITWRITE_API_KEY environment variable.
